items.title: [Sample] Polymer Degradation Kinetics Study
items.tagline: Modeling thermal degradation rates in engineering polymers
items.description: [Sample] An undergraduate research project modeling how processing temperature and residence time affect degradation kinetics in common engineering polymers, aimed at reducing scrap rates in extrusion processes.
items.problem: [Sample] High scrap rates during polymer extrusion were traced to inconsistent thermal degradation across batches.
items.solution: [Sample] Built a kinetics model from lab-scale thermal trials to recommend tighter processing windows.
items.results: [Sample] Proposed processing window reduced modeled scrap rate by double digits in simulation.

items.title: [Sample] Process Optimization Simulation Tool
items.tagline: A lightweight simulator for comparing manufacturing line configurations
items.description: [Sample] A small internal tool for comparing throughput and bottleneck tradeoffs across manufacturing line configurations before committing to physical changes.
items.problem: [Sample] Line reconfiguration decisions were being made without a fast way to compare tradeoffs.
items.solution: [Sample] Built a discrete-event simulation with a simple web front end for engineers to test configurations.

items.title: [Sample] Sustainable Packaging Materials Research
items.tagline: Evaluating bio-based alternatives to conventional packaging film
items.description: [Sample] Comparative research evaluating mechanical and barrier properties of bio-based film alternatives against conventional petroleum-based packaging.
items.problem: [Sample] Conventional packaging film has a large end-of-life environmental footprint.
items.solution: [Sample] Benchmarked candidate bio-based films against key performance properties.

items.title: [Sample] Future of Advanced Manufacturing — Foresight Report
items.tagline: A landscape scan of emerging drivers shaping manufacturing over the next decade
items.description: [Sample] A strategic foresight report synthesizing emerging technology, workforce, and policy signals into a set of drivers shaping the future of advanced manufacturing.

items.title: [Sample] Campus Sustainability Dashboard
items.tagline: A live dashboard tracking campus energy and waste metrics
items.description: [Sample] A small web dashboard aggregating campus energy usage and waste-diversion metrics to support a student sustainability initiative.
items.problem: [Sample] Sustainability metrics were scattered across disconnected spreadsheets.
items.solution: [Sample] Centralized the data into a single lightweight dashboard with weekly refreshes.
